entries.sus.title: Gukoresha Rinda byakugendekeye bite?
entries.sus.intro: Tubwire uko byari byoroshye gukoresha Rinda. Hitamo uko wemera buri nteruro. Ushobora gusimbuka iyo ari yo yose.
entries.sus.1: Ndatekereza ko nakwifuza gukoresha Rinda kenshi.
entries.sus.2: Nasanze Rinda igoye kurusha uko byari bikwiye.
entries.sus.4: Ndatekereza ko nakenera ubufasha bw'umuhanga mu ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo nkoreshe Rinda.
entries.sus.5: Nasanze ibice bitandukanye bya Rinda bikorana neza.
entries.sus.6: Natekereje ko muri Rinda harimo ibintu byinshi bidahuye.
entries.sus.7: Ndatekereza ko abantu benshi bamenya gukoresha Rinda vuba cyane.
entries.sus.9: Nagize icyizere cyinshi mu gukoresha Rinda.
entries.sus.10: Nagombye kwiga ibintu byinshi mbere yo gutangira gukoresha Rinda.
entries.sus.thanks: Murakoze. Ibisubizo byanyu bidufasha kunoza Rinda.
